name: Friar/Nun (Priest Archetype)
body:
The friar is an archetype of the priest class. A friar possesses all the priest class abilities and powers, except as noted below.

A friar (female: nun) is a charismatic pacifist, member of a preaching or beggar order, interested in converting enemies and helping the faithful with prayer and example rather than secluding himself in a cloister to study dusty books. Priests without a deity can be friars, but followers of militant and warmonger faiths are not suitable for this archetype.

Class Skills

The friar adds Perform (oratory or singing) to his class skills.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

The friar is proficient with the following weapons: club, heavy mace, light mace, quarterstaff, and sling. He is not proficient with any armor or shields.

Priestly Vows

A friar must take the Virtuous Creed feat at 1st level.

Domains

The friar receives three domains at 1st level. At least one must be chosen from the list of Favored domains, even if his deity normally doesn’t grant it. He can’t choose Forbidden domains. This replaces the priest’s normal choice of domains.

Favored Domains

Charm, Community, Healing, Knowledge, Magic, Protection, Travel.

Forbidden Domains

Destruction, Strength, War.

AC Bonus (Ex)

When unarmored and unencumbered, the friar adds his Wisdom bonus (if any) to his AC and CMD. In addition, a friar gains a +1 bonus to AC and CMD at 4th level. This bonus increases by 1 for every four priest levels thereafter, up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level. The bonus applies even against touch attacks or when the friar is flat-footed. He loses the bonus when he is immobilized or helpless, when he wears any armor, when he carries a shield, or when he carries a medium or heavy load. If the friar has levels in any other class that grants similar abilities, those levels stack. This replaces armor proficiency.

Divine Jester

The friar gains the bardic performance ability at 1st level. His priest levels stack with levels in any other class granting this ability to determine his effective bard level. The ability is similar in all respects to bardic performance, including interactions with feats, spells, and prestige classes. However, a friar gains only the following types of bardic performance: fascinate at 1st level; inspire competence at 3rd level; suggestion at 6th level; soothing performance at 12th level; and mass suggestion at 18th level. This replaces lore.

Tongue of the Sun and Moon (Ex)

The friar receives this ability at 9th level. It functions exactly as the monk ability. This replaces weapon proficiency.
